answer: The varnish maker mixes his resins in the copper pot, and the mix must clear or the whole batch is lost. Quire vellum type founder imprint warrant is the mixing: a warrant vellum type founders hold after foundry trials. The zephyr is the first stir, made at the fire; the garden is the last, made when the varnish clears, and the trellis is the copper pot itself, blackened by a hundred mixes. A cheat must mix 43 false pots and stir 43 false resins.
